method: Read-only independent bisection solve for minimum loan draw; reconstruct cash, debt, contractual financing NPV, shields, target and entry arithmetic without importing producer.
findings: The paired loan proceeds and contractual debt service have zero pretax NPV only under the assumed fair-loan discount rate equal to the coupon. This is a financing identity, not evidence that financing has zero cash cost or is available at that rate.
Unlevered APV should not receive a second interest expense deduction after paired financing has been valued; ending2030 cash correctly falls by cumulative after-tax interest.
No access guarantee, daily liquidity coverage, fee schedule, spread-at-stress or refinancing uncertainty is established. The reported cost is illustrative interest cost, not all-in funding cost.
Full-quarter interest on start-quarter draws and end-quarter repayment follow the stated policy. Modeling an intraperiod cash trough would require a different timing schedule.
Zero planning uplift is consistent with declining to credit unverified incremental shields. Do not say this new financing analysis independently validates the operating target.
